title: Black bands in the city: Green, Perez and a military band
summary: Asked about colored bands, Laine remembers Green's band and a short yellow leader's military band that played funerals, and Perez as a bandleader.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did you hear many of the colored bands? Did you hear many of the colored bands? No. At the time? No.

No. I remember only one that shortly after I, I organized. His name was Green. But there was another fella, and I can't remember his name right now. He, he had a pretty good band. He had a military band. And, uh, I can't remember his name. Uh, I, what did he look like? Yellow fella, short yellow fella. Yeah. Well, he had a pretty good band.

He had a pretty good military band. What was it called? The Imperial, or the Onward, or the Excelsior, something like that? Who's that? What was the name of it? The Imperial, or the Onward, or the Excelsior?

No, I didn't remember the name of his band at all. You mean, this fella's band? No, I don't remember. I don't remember. Where, where'd you hear the band? Around town. Just in the streets? Yeah, played funerals. Uh-huh. He played funerals. That's the time it was a rage for colored bands, you know, playing funerals. For colored.
Perez, or Morat, or something like that? Did he have, Morat?

Yeah. Paul Morat, no, no, no. Perez? That's it. That's it. He had a band. He was a leader, too. He had a band. This fella, I can't think of his name right now. It's right on my memory, too, his name. It's on the tip of my tongue. It'll come to you. You'll think of it when we leave. Yeah, I'll think of it. Well, he had a band, and, in fact, after he started, there were two or three bands started. It was a fella by the name, as I told you, Green. A fella by the name of Green started a band. He started a band when he lived on charter between Manavar and Spain. I remember him well, because it was my locality. See? And he started a band, and he went right along with it and made pretty good. See? Made pretty good. Yeah.
